name: Cod3x USD
oneLiner: cdxUSD is Cod3x's dollar stablecoin on Base, minted and burned by protocol-permissioned Facilitators against strategy-managed crypto and stablecoin collateral.
collateral: Facilitator-managed crypto and stablecoin collateral under Cod3x protocol limits and strategies
pegMechanism: Cod3x Facilitators can mint and burn cdxUSD under protocol-defined limits; supply is expected to remain sufficiently collateralized by strategy assets

oracleRisk.summary: cdxUSD supply is created through governance-limited Facilitator credit buckets rather than user CDPs whose collateral health is continuously priced for liquidation.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: Cod3x documents cdxUSD as a GHO-style system in which approved Facilitators receive bounded lines of credit and mint or burn under protocol limits. The token layer does not expose borrower-owned collateral positions, per-collateral health factors, or permissionless liquidation branches; any strategy risk belongs to the individual Facilitator rather than a shared cdxUSD liquidation engine.

sources.label: Base Blockscout verified CdxUSD source and ABI

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The verified Base source and ABI for the sole tracked CdxUSD deployment expose standard ERC-20 transfer/transferFrom plus facilitator mint/burn, but no holder blacklist, freeze, seizure, or global ERC-20 pause path. Live latest-state reads from Base PublicNode during review returned owner=0xc0D3700924301AC384E5Eae3272E08220752DE3D, guardian=0x0D1d0f89cb988678B37FD5b5c6C1A5bBdc55f8ba, lzPause=false, one facilitator, and a 24-hour owner TimelockController; a 1-wei transfer simulation from the funded facilitator returned true. These are current live observations, not a claimed archival replay. The guardian can call pauseBridge(), but source confines that switch to LayerZero _debit/send(), not ordinary ERC-20 transfers; the owner can adjust facilitator/OFT parameters but cannot add holder-freeze logic to this deployed code. Cod3x Terms reserve Application access only, not token-balance control. Inherited: issuer materials describe facilitator credit against stablecoin collateral, but neither current nor archived disclosures identify its current collateral or custodian composition. The Upstream status records that unresolved collateral exposure without naming an issuer or asserting it can directly freeze cdxUSD holders.

mintAuthority.summary: cdxUSD uses a GHO-style facilitator bucket model on Base. The active 3/9 Safe facilitator mints within a finite bucket. The owner contract is a TimelockController (24h delay) with the 3/9 Safe as PROPOSER and 1/8 guardian Safe as EXECUTOR. The OFT LayerZero extension is present in code but has zero configured peers — no cross-chain mint surface active.

reserves.name: Facilitator-managed crypto and stablecoin collateral
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Cod3x Facilitators (including Cod3x Lend) strategy collateral

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
reserveReview.rationale: Cod3x documents cdxUSD as minted and burned by protocol-approved Facilitators (with Cod3x Lend as the primary issuance Facilitator) under strategy limits, and states the design is intended to keep every cdxUSD sufficiently backed. No current primary source publishes the facilitator collateral inventory, strategy positions, or coverage ratio, so the single aggregate envelope is retained with explicit v9 classification rather than invented constituent weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Cod3x Facilitator design documentation; no current reserve inventory published
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The facilitator-held collateral assets, strategy positions, obligors, and current coverage ratio behind cdxUSD are not disclosed by a current primary source.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Cod3x's Facilitator design is documented, but no reviewed source identifies the current collateral assets or reconciles them to cdxUSD supply.

providers.name: Cod3x protocol and Facilitator strategy contracts

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: cdxUSD collateral is managed by Facilitator strategies under protocol limits rather than held by a named custodian. The reviewed sources do not establish account segregation, insolvency treatment, rehypothecation terms, or provider-level allocation.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: cdxUSD is an omnichain stablecoin moved cross-chain as a LayerZero OFT; the exact captured supply sits on Base, where the OFT contract is the mint/burn authority for the representation.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-3 (lead usds-sky) (2026-07-20)
bridgeRouteRisk.sourceFreeRationale: The tracked cdxUSD contract set has one Base deployment, and reviewed Cod3x material describes mint/burn facilitators rather than a cross-chain token route.

routes.reviewNote: Controller verified on-chain 2026-07-20: endpoint() of the Cod3x USD token on Base returns the LayerZero EndpointV2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fE728c, so this deployment is the Cod3x OFT and the OFT contract itself is the mint/burn authority for the representation (totalSupply 6,150,000 cdxUSD, matching the exact captured supply; OFT owner/delegate 0xc0d3700924301ac384e5eae3272e08220752de3d).
